# CLI reference

`ragkit` commands, generated from `ragkit.cli`. Run any command with `--help` for the same information. Commands that read a project look for `ragkit.yaml` in the current directory or its parents.

## `ragkit add agent`

Copy an agent template into this project's agents folder.

```
ragkit add agent [OPTIONS] TEMPLATE
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TEMPLATE` | string | **required** | Built-in name (see `ragkit templates`), a local folder, or gh:owner/repo/path[@ref]. |
| `--name` | string | — | Name for the new agent. |
| `--force`, `--no-force` | flag | `False` | Overwrite an existing agent folder. |

## `ragkit agents`

List the agents in this project.

```
ragkit agents
```

## `ragkit chat`

Send one message to an agent and stream its reply.

```
ragkit chat [OPTIONS] AGENT MESSAGE
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENT` | string | **required** | Agent name. |
| `MESSAGE` | string | **required** | Message to send. |
| `--thread` | string | — | Thread id to continue. |

## `ragkit collections`

Show each collection's size and embedding model.

```
ragkit collections
```

## `ragkit eval agent`

Run each agent's eval dataset and check its gates.

```
ragkit eval agent [OPTIONS] AGENTS...
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AGENTS` | string, repeatable | **required** | Agents to evaluate. |
| `--dataset` | path | — | JSONL cases (default: evals.dataset in agent.yaml). |
| `--judge`, `--no-judge` | flag | `True` | Grade correctness and groundedness with an LLM. |
| `--gate`, `--no-gate` | flag | `True` | Exit 1 when a gate in agent.yaml fails. |
| `--output` | path | — | Write the JSON report here. |

## `ragkit eval search`

Measure hit rate, recall and MRR of a collection's search.

```
ragkit eval search [OPTIONS] COLLECTION DATASET
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COLLECTION` | string | **required** | Collection to search. |
| `DATASET` | path | **required** | JSONL with "query" and "expected_sources". |
| `--top-k`, `-k` | integer | `5` |  |
| `--mode` | string, repeatable | — | dense, sparse or hybrid; repeat to compare. |
| `--rerank`, `--no-rerank` | flag | `True` | Apply the project's reranker. |
| `--gate` | string, repeatable | — | metric=threshold, e.g. recall=0.8; exit 1 below it. |
| `--output` | path | — | Write the JSON report here. |

## `ragkit ingest`

Fetch, parse, chunk, embed and index the configured sources.

```
ragkit ingest [OPTIONS] [COLLECTIONS...]
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COLLECTIONS` | string, repeatable | — | Collections to ingest (default: all). |
| `--full`, `--no-full` | flag | `False` | Re-process every item, not just changed ones. |
| `--queue` | flag | `False` | Queue jobs for `ragkit worker` instead of running. |

## `ragkit init`

Create a new ragkit project.

```
ragkit init [OPTIONS] [PATH]
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `PATH` | path | `.` | Directory to create the project in. |
| `--name` | string | — | Project name (default: folder name). |
| `--model` | string | `google_genai:gemini-3.5-flash-lite` | Default model as provider:model. |

## `ragkit jobs`

List recent ingestion jobs.

```
ragkit jobs [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--collection` | string | — | Only this collection. |
| `--limit` | integer | `20` | How many to show. |

## `ragkit scheduler`

Queue collections whose sync_every has elapsed, until stopped.

Run one of these when workers scale to zero; otherwise `ragkit worker`
schedules by itself.

```
ragkit scheduler [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--every` | number | `60` | Seconds between checks. |

## `ragkit search`

Search a collection and print the best passages.

```
ragkit search [OPTIONS] COLLECTION QUERY
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COLLECTION` | string | **required** | Collection to search. |
| `QUERY` | string | **required** | Search text. |
| `--top-k`, `-k` | integer | `5` |  |
| `--mode` | string | `hybrid` | dense, sparse or hybrid. |
| `--rerank`, `--no-rerank` | flag | `True` | Apply the project's reranker. |

## `ragkit serve`

Serve this project's agents over HTTP.

```
ragkit serve [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--host` | string | — | Defaults to server.host. |
| `--port` | integer | — | Defaults to server.port. |
| `--reload`, `--no-reload` | flag | `False` | Restart on code changes. |
| `--workers` | integer | `1` | Server processes; use the postgres checkpointer with more than 1. |

## `ragkit templates`

List the agent templates you can add.

```
ragkit templates
```

## `ragkit version`

Show the installed ragkit version.

```
ragkit version
```

## `ragkit worker`

Run queued ingestion jobs until stopped (SIGTERM finishes running jobs first).

```
ragkit worker [OPTIONS]
```

| Argument / option | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--concurrency` | integer | `1` | Jobs to run at once. |
| `--schedule`, `--no-schedule` | flag | `True` | Also queue collections whose sync_every has elapsed. |
| `--until-idle` | flag | `False` | Exit when the queue is empty. |
